card.name: Inside foreign names and Arabic terms
card.fires_on: Short endings such as un, ln, alon, en or atan partway through foreign words, mostly transliterated Arabic or Hungarian names and terms, in general web text.

modes.label: Arabic plural endings
modes.description: The ending 'un' on transliterated Arabic words in Quran-style passages.

modes.label: Hungarian place names
modes.description: A middle piece inside Hungarian place or mountain names.

modes.label: Other foreign names
modes.description: A middle piece of other foreign names or terms, such as Mahalanobis or Al-Watan.

card.plain: It fires in the middle of unfamiliar foreign names, especially Arabic and Hungarian ones, where the word is not yet finished.
